text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Nn, huh? What was that... just now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was a phenomenon hard to believe at 
first glance... Yet, this sensation—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Power is overflowing...!\r I feel like I 
can put my new theories into practice!
